title: Assembly of the separate finite normalization equations
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring object, A a finite commutative ring killed by a positive integer N, and Y a Noetherian scheme on which N is invertible, with N invertible also on W=diagonalSurface Y. Put P=ProjectiveLine Y. Give a Diagram d with line family L [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], finite realizations eY,eP,eW and lineP,lineW isomorphisms to the positive finite Cartier lines [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line]. Give a supported-source isomorphism with exactly the underlying direct image of eP's coefficient-unit comparison. Give a finite q_* model Rq, an equality q_canonical with geoP1Pushforward, its full IsCanonicalRightDerived equation, a FinitePushSquare, and a splitting whose hom is geoP1TwistedMap. If the two separate arrow predicates [def-diagonal-finite-arrow-equations] hold for these supplied data, then FiniteDiagonalComparison [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-diagonal] holds for the same d, realizations and line isomorphisms. This is solely the logical assembly of supplied witnesses and equations.

proof.text: Unfold the supplied presented trace predicate and the two generic arrow predicates. Project the supported-source isomorphism and normalization and all six fields of the supplied trace presentation. Insert these witnesses and both arrow equalities into FiniteDiagonalComparison, in its existing order.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDiagonalComparison_of_equations [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X) (d : Diagram R Y L)
    (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y) (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : FiniteRealization R A (diagonalSurface Y))
    (lineP : eP.F.obj (L (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (lineW : eW.F.obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (diagonalSurface Y))
    (sourceComparison : FiniteSourceComparison R A Y eP eW)
    (p : FiniteTracePresentation R A N hN hA Y hY L d eY eP)
    (hclass : FiniteCartierArrowEquation R A N hN hA Y hW L d eW lineW
      sourceComparison.iso)
    (htrace : FinitePresentedTraceEquation R A N hN hA Y hY L d eY eP lineP p) :
    FiniteDiagonalComparison R A N hN hA Y hY hW L d eY eP eW lineP lineW
